plan: Model all patient-facing state as a single public `session` dictionary with exactly the four contract keys, reset via one `_initial_session` factory used by construction, `begin`, and `abandon`.
Copy the `appointments` sequence (each entry as a fresh dict) at construction and precompute the set of known ids for validation; build choice dicts in input order on demand.
Route `handle` through a class-level dispatch table mapping the six action types to guarded handler methods; reject non-dict actions and unknown/unhashable types up front.

Have each handler validate preconditions (active/incomplete session, required payload types, known appointment ids) and return an explanatory `Error:` screen without mutating state when validation fails, so accepted data is never corrupted and nothing raises.

Centralize screen construction in one builder that enforces the invariant: choices are the appointment list exactly when the prompt is `Choose appointment`, otherwise empty; messages default to an empty list.

Derive prompts deterministically: fixed prompts for accepted transitions (`Confirm contact`, `Choose appointment`, `Review and complete`, `Check-in complete`, `Session abandoned`) and a next-unmet-prompt computation for corrections and error screens.

Inject `action_source` and `screen_sink` through the constructor as duck-typed collaborators (`read_action()` / `display(screen)`), so unittest fakes from the standard library replace them; `run_once` raises `RuntimeError` before touching either if one is missing, then reads one action, handles it, displays the resulting screen exactly once, and returns that same object.
mechanisms: single mutable session dictionary as sole source of truth
dispatch table of guarded per-action handler methods
validate-then-mutate ordering so rejected actions leave session untouched
centralized screen builder enforcing the prompt/choices invariant
next-unmet-prompt derivation for corrections and error screens
constructor-injected duck-typed action source and screen sink for test fakes
run_once precondition check raising RuntimeError before any collaborator call
